desc: Derive necessary and sufficient invariants, including per-zero position residues modulo \(Y\) and zero-position sum modulo \(XY\).
Establish sufficiency of the invariants for movable strings and handle exceptional frozen components.
Develop an \(O(N)\)-time algorithm covering all edge cases, including \(X=1\), \(Y=1\), \(X=Y\), and \(X+Y>N\).
Validate the characterization against the public samples and the supplied counterexample.
Translate the algorithm into the required Python stdin/stdout format.
